title: SoftBank, ABB Weigh China Carve-Out to Salvage $5.4 Billion Robotics Deal
summary: SoftBank and ABB are considering separating ABB&\#x27;s China robotics operations into a standalone entity with different shareholding rights, in an attempt to rescue their $5.4 billion acquisition after China&\#x27;s foreign investment security review office halted the deal on Thursday, Bloomberg reported. People familiar with the matter said the plan may fail and that ABB is also weighing alternatives, including finding another buyer; those people put a possible valuation of $2 billion to $3 billion on the business. Both companies declined to comment, Bloomberg said.
